name: WiPE-FaLl
summary: Wireless CSI amplitude dataset for estimating low, medium, and high fall likelihood from simulated timed up-and-go tests.

hardware.platform: Two USRP X300 software-defined radios with VERT2450 antennas

settings.scenario: One subject performs a 3 m Timed Up-and-Go path in Room 511 under three simulated balance-risk conditions

original.license: CC BY 4.0; files supplied on request

standardization.notes: Each official amplitude CSV becomes [T, 51, 1, 1]. Preserve all 51 subcarriers and the single USRP link. The README does not report the CSI sampling rate, so a requested 100 Hz fall-risk view is recorded as a target-grid assumption rather than a measured resampling rate. Preserve the official training versus unseen folder split.
